newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares rise as realty firms top turnover.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares rise as realty firms top turnover.

text.p: Egyptian shares rose on Wednesday on active trade in popular realty firms, which ended mixed.
The Capital Market Authority overall index climbed 2.95 points to 323.08 in 25.8 million pounds ($7.6 million) turnover.

Medinet Nasr Housing and Development shares rose 5.59 pounds to close at 424.1. It was the day's most active share with 2 million pounds turnover, followed by Heliopolis Housing and Development with 1.9 million pounds.
But the Heliopolis share price fell, shedding 4.0 pounds to close at 462.
Amriyah Cement, which was Tuesday's most active share, was among the top ten gainers when its share price closed up 3.44 pounds at 74.
Suez Cement was also the focus of active trade, but its share price ended 1.00 pounds lower at 62 pounds.
The index for openly traded firms rose to 514.95 points from 507.92 on Tuesday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms also rose to 219.37 from 218.
Of the 68 shares traded, 35 advanced, 20 declined and the remaining 13 ended the day unchanged.
